ambiguities_or_notes: The audited witness reads ‘{ полевых же артилеристов)’ and later ‘что л не ошибаюсь’. Independent Tolstoy witnesses quote the passage as ‘(полевых же артиллеристов)’ and ‘что я не ошибаюсь’; English follows those verified character-level readings while retaining the original Russian source hash.
из рук вон плохим и недостаточным is rendered ‘extremely poor and inadequate’; the idiomatic force is preserved without reproducing the Russian idiom mechanically.
собственно на Малахов Курган is rendered ‘specifically on Malakhov Kurgan,’ preserving the focus on that particular assault.
All five editorial-note paragraphs and the Malakhov Kurgan footnote are translated; the page-334 break is retained in editorial note 3.
